question: Can a bounded virtual torso-leveling search preserve positive-bearing feet while allowing unsupported feet to make feasible downward placement moves, avoiding the all-foot exact-IK deadlock and all-hip recentering failure?

population.selection: All 600 nonterminal samples in original order.

algorithm.bearing_rule: Presence, bears_support, ordinary unilateral contact and positive normal impulse; an anchoring choice, not qualified support.
algorithm.body_candidates: Five scales 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16; three heading translations -d,0,+d; three vertical translations -d,0,+d; level blend 0 or +0.6*dt*scale. 90 candidates.
algorithm.loaded_legs: Exact original two-branch inverse kinematics to preserve modeled world foot positions; original 0.0005 m unactuated lateral residual and 4 rad/s joint-step bounds.
algorithm.unsupported_legs: Desired world endpoint is previous modeled endpoint displaced down by d. Use damped local two-joint Jacobian least squares with damping squared 1e-4 m^2/rad^2; bounded five-scale line search plus unchanged joints. Select minimum squared endpoint error, with original joint and speed limits and <=0.1*dt fixed-torso FK displacement.
algorithm.pose_checks: Reject worse torso-up direction, upward unsupported world endpoint motion, or an anchored foot exceeding the original lateral residual.
algorithm.cost: Original horizontal COM-to-four-foot-center squared distance plus 0.04*tilt_rad^2 plus squared positive unsupported-foot height gaps. Add squared torso height error: original 0.92-leg-height goal only when all four feet bear; otherwise current torso height.
algorithm.selection: First strictly cost-decreasing minimum in declared candidate order; improvement epsilon 1e-12. Explicit no-feasible/no-improvement result, no fallback law.

checks: Verify complete original report identity and sample population.
Record feasible and selected counts, all refusals, anchor endpoint error, unsupported motion and torso-up change.
Check original joint limits and target-step bounds; independent FK verifies every selected target.
Compare original V26 mode and contact mask without regrading any physical observation.
decision_rules: Model constraints and geometry only; no rigid-body dynamics, friction, motor force or contact prediction.
Do not select a physical controller from geometry alone.
Retain every negative and refusal; changing an observed algorithm requires a distinct study identity.
A selected virtual torso pose is never directly imposed on a native body.
No physical population, source-key renewal, threshold change or actuator-cap change is authorized.
